QF.id: Retirement Planning Products: Other Investment Products_10

question.text: The Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS) is available to individuals aged:

explanation.text: The Logic: SCSS is available to individuals aged 60 years and above, as per the workbook. The Trap: Lower age thresholds such as 55 or 58 are common distractors and are not supported by the workbook pages checked. Note: SCSS offers competitive interest and Section 80C tax benefit, making it a useful post-retirement income product for senior citizens.
